gloss: layering; wearing multiple layers of clothing

definitions.gloss: layering; wearing multiple layers of clothing
definitions.explanation: The practice of wearing several garments on top of each other, either for warmth or as a fashion style. Common in discussions about winter dressing and fashion coordination.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}が{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: Layering is the basics in winter.

examples.japanese: {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}をすると{暖|あたた}かい。
おしゃれな{重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}のコーディネートを{紹介|しょうかい}します。
examples.english: I'll introduce some stylish layered outfit ideas.

examples.japanese: {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}しすぎて{動|うご}きにくくなった。
examples.english: I layered so many clothes that it became hard to move.

notes:
Compound of {重|かさ}ねる (to pile up, layer) and {着|ぎ} (wearing). Also used as a verb with する: {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}する. In fashion, layering is treated as both a practical cold-weather strategy and a style technique.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}する: to layer clothes
- {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}コーデ: layered outfit coordination
- おしゃれな{重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}: stylish layering
- {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}しすぎる: to over-layer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {着込|きこ}む: to bundle up — verb emphasizing putting on many layers for warmth
- {厚着|あつぎ}: heavy dressing — wearing thick or warm clothing; opposite of {薄着|うすぎ}
- {薄着|うすぎ}: light dressing — wearing few or thin layers of clothing
